text:
[ITST.6.4] Reviews reject tests that:

- Depend on real-time sleeps or wall-clock timing.
  Use the mock clock for anything time-sensitive.
- Probe or assert on private struct layouts beyond
  the minimum the test requires (impl tests).
- Reach internal headers from a spec test
  (spec/ -only rule; see [ISTS.1]).
- Give a spec test's scenario a bare descriptive name
  without an `<id>` ([ITST.5.3]).
- Use short-circuit `main()` per [ITST.5.4].
- Leak allocations. `ds_engine_free` at end of each
  scenario catches most.
